Several waveforms aregood candidates for being included in 6G, and consensus has not been yet achieved within the community. However, most waveforms currently envisaged are based on orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM), mainly due to the legacy technology developments from both 4G and 5G. Orthogonal time-frequency-space (OTFS) waveform is a particularly popular candidate, as it is being thoroughlyinvestigated by academia. This activity shall develop an end-to-end software demonstrator for the physical layer of at least two candidate waveforms for 6G, one of which shall be OTFS. For all the considered waveforms, reduced-complexity transmitter and receiver algorithms shall be designed, implemented, and tested in the software demonstrator for bidirectional links over representative satellite channels.
